page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8163 processor. Operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, this instance features 96 physical cores and 96 virtual CPUs, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation with 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It runs on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Network connectivity for this instance is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The absence of bundled local storage requires reliance on external block storage solutions. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory density provides a stable resource profile for enterprise workloads, avoiding the performance fluctuations associated with shared-core or hyperthreaded environments.

Given the memory-optimized configuration of 768.0 GB RAM and 96 dedicated physical cores, the ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and heavy data processing tasks that require substantial memory capacity without GPU acceleration.
